add_additional_email.description: Use this resource to add a new additional email address to account. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:profile:write.
add_additional_email.title: Add additional e-mail

add_order_billing_document_link.description: Used to upload a URL to a billing document. You can add up to 10 links. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
add_order_billing_document_link.title: Add order billing document link

add_order_invoice.description: Use to add new invoice metadata. Before you send an invoice file, you need to initialize the invoice instance with the required parameters. Allegro marks this operation as deprecated. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
add_order_invoice.title: Add order invoice

add_order_tracking_number.description: Add a parcel tracking number (shipment) to given order line items. This resource is rate limited to 50 requests per second. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get order tracking numbers. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
add_order_tracking_number.title: Add order tracking number

add_tax_identification_number.description: Use this resource to add tax identification number. For international sellers only. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
add_tax_identification_number.title: Add tax identification number

answer_rating.description: Use this resource to answer for received rating. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:ratings.
answer_rating.title: Answer rating

apply_for_badge.description: This resource allows you to apply for a badge. Most badges involve additional fee charged. Your badge application will be verified and you will be notified about the verification status via e-mail. You can use *Location* provided in header of the response to track your application status. Application will be removed after 30 days when status of the application was changed form PROCESSED or DECLINED. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get badge application. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
apply_for_badge.title: Apply for badge

apply_for_commission_refund.description: Use this resource to create a refund application. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
apply_for_commission_refund.title: Apply for commission refund

assign_packages_to_classified.description: Use this resource to assign classified packages to an offer. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
assign_packages_to_classified.title: Assign packages to classified

assign_tags_to_offer.description: Use this resource to assign a tag to offer. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
assign_tags_to_offer.title: Assign tags to offer

calculate_offer_fee_and_commission.description: Provides information about fee and commission for an offer. This resource is limited to 25 requests per second for a single user. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.
calculate_offer_fee_and_commission.title: Calculate offer fee and commission

cancel_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to cancel an Advance Ship Notice in IN_TRANSIT status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
cancel_advance_ship_notice.title: Cancel advance ship notice

cancel_commission_refund_application.description: Use this resource to cancel a refund application. This cannot be undone. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
cancel_commission_refund_application.title: Cancel commission refund application

cancel_shipment.description: Use this resource to cancel parcel. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get shipment cancellation status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:shipments:write.
cancel_shipment.title: Cancel shipment

change_automatic_pricing_of_many_offers.description: Use this resource to modify the automatic pricing rules of multiple offers at the same time. This resource is rate limited to 150 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute - limit applies to a single user of the application. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get automatic pricing command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_automatic_pricing_of_many_offers.title: Change automatic pricing of many offers

change_buy_now_price_of_offer.description: Use this resource to change the Buy Now price in a single offer. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome from Allegro afterwards. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_buy_now_price_of_offer.title: Change Buy Now price of offer

change_claim_status.description: Change the formal status of a claim, for example accept or reject it. Not a valid operation for disputes. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:disputes.
change_claim_status.title: Change claim status

change_price_of_many_offers.description: Change price of offers. This resource is rate limited to 150 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute - limit applies to a single user of the application. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get price change command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_price_of_many_offers.title: Change price of many offers

change_prices_and_stock_of_many_offers_b.description: Bulk price and stock modification. Contrary to standard batch price or stock modification, it lets you modify both price and stock modification across multiple offers, or within the same offer but in a separate modification unit. Change price and stock of offers. This resource is rate limited to 150 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute - limit applies to a single user of the application. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get price and stock command summary (beta). Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.

processing.check_title: Get price and stock command summary (beta)

change_prices_and_stock_of_many_offers_b.title: Change prices and stock of many offers (beta)

change_promotion_packages_of_many_offers.description: Use this resource to modify promotion packages on multiple offers at once. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get promotion package command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_promotion_packages_of_many_offers.title: Change promotion packages of many offers

change_promotion_packages_of_offer.description: Use this resource to modify offer promotion packages. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_promotion_packages_of_offer.title: Change promotion packages of offer

change_stock_of_many_offers.description: Change quantity of multiple offers. This resource is rate limited to 250 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute - limit applies to a single user of the application. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get stock change command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
change_stock_of_many_offers.title: Change stock of many offers

check_offer_processing_status.description: The URI for the resource given by Location header of POST /sale/product-offers and PATCH /sale/product-offers/{offerId}. Use this resource to check processing status of a POST or PATCH request. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.
check_offer_processing_status.title: Check offer processing status

create_additional_services_group.description: Use this resource to create a group of additional services. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_additional_services_group.title: Create additional services group

create_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to create an Advance Ship Notice. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
create_advance_ship_notice.title: Create advance ship notice

create_automatic_pricing_rule.description: Use this resource to create automatic pricing rule. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
create_automatic_pricing_rule.title: Create automatic pricing rule

create_dispute_attachment.description: Use this resource to post an attachment declaration. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:disputes.
create_dispute_attachment.title: Create dispute attachment

create_flexible_bundle.description: You can create flexible bundle using this resource. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
create_flexible_bundle.title: Create flexible bundle

create_implied_warranty.description: Use this resource to create an implied warranty definition. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_implied_warranty.title: Create implied warranty

create_message_attachment.description: Use this resource to add attachment declaration before uploading. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
create_message_attachment.title: Create message attachment

create_offer_attachment.description: You can attach pdf, jpeg or png files to your offers. We will present them under the offer description in the Additional information section. You can attach multiple files to one offer – one per each type from the list: Guide (MANUAL). Allowed media types: PDF Special offer terms (SPECIAL_OFFER_RULES). Allowed media types: PDF Competition terms (COMPETITION_RULES). Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
create_offer_attachment.title: Create offer attachment

create_offer_contact.description: Use this resource to create a new contact. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_offer_contact.title: Create offer contact

create_offer_from_product.description: Use this resource to create offer based on product. Note that requests may be limited. When Allegro answers HTTP 202 it has accepted the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Check offer processing status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
create_offer_from_product.title: Create offer from product

create_offer_tag.description: Use this resource to create a new tag. You can create up to 100 tags. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_offer_tag.title: Create offer tag

create_point_of_service.description: Use this resource to create a point of service. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_point_of_service.title: Create point of service

create_promotion.description: This endpoint creates a new promotion. You can create promotions only if your base marketplace is allegro-pl. Created promotions are visible only on the allegro-pl marketplace. You can define the following types of promotions: 1. Large order discount Only company users will see and be eligible for this type of promotion. In order to create a large order discount, you also have to be a company user. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
create_promotion.title: Create promotion

create_responsible_person.description: Use this resource to create a new responsible person for the compliance of the product with EU regulations. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_responsible_person.title: Create responsible person

create_responsible_producer.description: Use this resource to create a new responsible producer for the compliance of the product with EU regulations. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_responsible_producer.title: Create responsible producer

create_return_policy.description: Use this resource to create a return policy definition. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_return_policy.title: Create return policy

create_shipment.description: Use this resource to create shipment for delivery. Please check also new resource '/shipment-management/delivery-proposals/{orderId}' to get prefilled request body for this resource. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get shipment creation status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:shipments:write.
create_shipment.title: Create shipment

create_shipping_rate_set.description: Use this resource to create a new seller's shipping rates set. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_shipping_rate_set.title: Create shipping rate set

create_size_table.description: Use this resource to create size table. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_size_table.title: Create size table

create_warranty.description: Use this resource to create a warranty definition. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_warranty.title: Create warranty

create_warranty_attachment.description: You can attach PDF files to warranties. Uploading attachments flow: 1. Create an attachment object to receive an upload URL (*POST /after-sales-service-conditions/attachments*), 2. Use the upload URL to submit the PDF file (*PUT /after-sales-service-conditions/attachments/{attachmentId}*), 3. Create (or update) warranty with attachment (*POST /after-sales-service-conditions/warranties*). Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
create_warranty_attachment.title: Create warranty attachment

deactivate_promotion.description: Use this resource to deactivate the requested promotion. You need to use its unique id., Wholesale price list, Multipack. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
deactivate_promotion.title: Deactivate promotion

delete_additional_email.description: Use this resource to delete one of additional emails. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:profile:write.
delete_additional_email.title: Delete additional e-mail

delete_additional_services_group_transla.description: Use this resource to delete the translation for specified additional service group and language. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
delete_additional_services_group_transla.title: Delete additional services group translation

delete_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to delete an Advance Ship Notice. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
delete_advance_ship_notice.title: Delete advance ship notice

delete_automatic_pricing_rule.description: Use this resource to delete automatic pricing rule. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
delete_automatic_pricing_rule.title: Delete automatic pricing rule

delete_draft_offer.description: Use this resource to delete a draft offer. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
delete_draft_offer.title: Delete draft offer

delete_flexible_bundle.description: Use this resource to delete flexible bundle by its unique identifier. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
delete_flexible_bundle.title: Delete flexible bundle

delete_message.description: Use this resource to delete message with provided identifier. This resource is deprecated and will be removed in the future. Allegro marks this operation as deprecated. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
delete_message.title: Delete message

delete_offer_bundle.description: Use this resource to delete offer bundle by its unique identifier. Allegro marks this operation as deprecated. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
delete_offer_bundle.title: Delete offer bundle

delete_offer_tag.description: Use this resource to delete the tag. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
delete_offer_tag.title: Delete offer tag

delete_offer_translation.description: Delete single element or entire manual translation. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.

query.description: Offer element for which translation should be deleted. If not provided, translations for all elements will be deleted.
query.name: element

query.description: ProductId for which safety information translation should be deleted. If not provided, safety information translations for all products in offer will be deleted.
query.name: products.id

delete_offer_translation.title: Delete offer translation

delete_point_of_service.description: Use this resource to delete a point of service. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
delete_point_of_service.title: Delete point of service

delete_responsible_producer.description: Use this resource to delete a responsible producer created by you. The responsible producer can be deleted only if it is not assigned to any offer, otherwise the request is rejected and the responsible producer is not deleted. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
delete_responsible_producer.title: Delete responsible producer

delete_return_policy.description: Use this resource to delete a return policy definition. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
delete_return_policy.title: Delete return policy

download_advance_ship_notice_labels.description: Use this resource to get labels for Advance Ship Notice. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.
download_advance_ship_notice_labels.title: Download advance ship notice labels

download_customer_return_form.description: Use this resource to download a PDF document containing details of a customer return. If buyer data is unavailable, the document is generated without it. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:read.
download_customer_return_form.title: Download customer return form

download_dispute_attachment.description: Use this resource to get an attachment. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:disputes.
download_dispute_attachment.title: Download dispute attachment

download_message_attachment.description: Use this resource to download attachment with provided identifier. You can retrieve attachments uploaded within the last 6 months. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
download_message_attachment.title: Download message attachment

download_shipment_labels.description: Use this resource to get label for created shipment. Returned content type depends on created shipment. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:shipments:read.
download_shipment_labels.title: Download shipment labels

download_shipment_protocol.description: Protocol availability depends on Carrier. The answer is saved as a workflow file. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:shipments:read.
download_shipment_protocol.title: Download shipment protocol

edit_offer.description: Use this resource to edit an offer. This resource allows you to edit each field independently, so you can update a single field, such as the price or quantity, several fields, or all supported offer fields in a single request. In general, fields omitted from the request remain unchanged. The request follows RFC 7396: arrays are replaced as a whole, and setting a field to null removes it. When Allegro answers HTTP 202 it has accepted the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Check offer processing status. The specification names no Allegro permission for it.
edit_offer.title: Edit offer

exclude_offers_from_allegro_prices.description: Use this resource to submit a command to exclude offers from the Allegro Prices program. Returns a command ID that can be used to track the processing status. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get Allegro Prices exclusion status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
exclude_offers_from_allegro_prices.title: Exclude offers from Allegro Prices

get_additional_email.description: Use this resource to retrieve a single additional email. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:profile:read.
get_additional_email.title: Get additional e-mail

get_additional_emails.description: Use this resource to get a list of all additional email addresses assigned to account. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:profile:read.
get_additional_emails.title: Get additional e-mails

get_additional_service_definitions.description: Use this resource to get additional services definitions, grouped by additional services categories, available on given marketplace. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.
get_additional_service_definitions.title: Get additional service definitions

get_additional_services_group.description: Use this resource to get additional services group for a given ID. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.
get_additional_services_group.title: Get additional services group

get_additional_services_group_translatio.description: Use this resource to get translations for additional service group. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.

query.description: IETF language tag. When provided, the response will contain translations in only that language (if exists).
query.name: language

get_additional_services_group_translatio.title: Get additional services group translations

get_additional_services_groups.description: Use this resource to retrieve a list of groups with additional services available to a given user which you may assign to offers. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.

query.description: The offset of elements in the response.
query.name: offset

query.description: The limit of elements in the response.
query.name: limit

get_additional_services_groups.title: Get additional services groups

get_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to get an Advance Ship Notice. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.
get_advance_ship_notice.title: Get advance ship notice

get_advance_ship_notice_receiving_state.description: Use this resource to check the state of Advance Ship Notice receiving in Fulfillment Center in real time. The response contains a receiving progress and information about particular items - their quantities and conditions. While the Advance Ship Notice is in UNPACKING state, report is updated dynamically, which might result in different responses even at short time intervals. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.
get_advance_ship_notice_receiving_state.title: Get advance ship notice receiving state

get_advance_ship_notice_submission_statu.description: Use this resource to get submit status of the Advance Ship Notice. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.
get_advance_ship_notice_submission_statu.title: Get advance ship notice submission status

get_advance_ship_notices.description: Use this resource to get a list of Advance Ship Notices. The list is ordered by createdAt property. Default offset is 0, default limit is 50. A list can be filtered by statuses. Multiple status query parameters are allowed. In such cases, filters are joined with OR logical operator. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.

query.description: The offset of elements in the response.
query.name: offset

query.description: Maximum number of elements in response.
query.name: limit

query.description: A status of the Advance Ship Notices in the response.
query.name: status

get_advance_ship_notices.title: Get advance ship notices

get_alle_discount_campaigns.description: List current AlleDiscount campaigns. Each campaign has its own list of goods (products) that indicate which offers can be submitted to it. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.

query.description: Id of the searched campaign. If present, returns at most one entry.
query.name: campaignId

get_alle_discount_campaigns.title: Get AlleDiscount campaigns

get_alle_discount_submission_status.description: Use this resource to get information about the submit offer command execution status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_alle_discount_submission_status.title: Get AlleDiscount submission status

get_alle_discount_withdrawal_status.description: Use this resource to get information about the withdrawal command execution status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_alle_discount_withdrawal_status.title: Get AlleDiscount withdrawal status

get_allegro_pickup_and_drop_off_points.description: Get a list of Allegro pickup drop off points. The specification names no Allegro permission for it.

get_allegro_pickup_and_drop_off_points.title: Get Allegro pickup and drop-off points

get_allegro_prices_exclusion_status.description: Use this resource to retrieve the status and details of a previously submitted exclusion command. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_allegro_prices_exclusion_status.title: Get Allegro Prices exclusion status

get_allegro_prices_participation.description: Use this resource to retrieve the account participation status for all supported marketplaces in the Allegro Prices program. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_allegro_prices_participation.title: Get Allegro Prices participation

get_allegro_prices_submission_status.description: Use this resource to retrieve the status and details of a previously submitted offer command. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_allegro_prices_submission_status.title: Get Allegro Prices submission status

get_automatic_pricing_command_report.description: Defaults: limit = 100, offset = 0. Returns status and report of the offer-price-automation-command. This resource is rate limited to retrieving information about 270 000 offer changes per minute. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.

get_automatic_pricing_command_summary.title: Get automatic pricing command summary

get_automatic_pricing_rule.description: Use this resource to get automatic pricing rule by id. Rules with property default set to true are default rules created by Allegro for each merchant and cannot be modified. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.
get_automatic_pricing_rule.title: Get automatic pricing rule

get_automatic_pricing_rules.description: Use this resource to get automatic pricing rules. Rules with property default set to true are default rules created by Allegro for each merchant. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.
get_automatic_pricing_rules.title: Get automatic pricing rules

get_automatic_pricing_rules_of_offer.description: Use this resource to get automatic pricing rules for offer. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.
get_automatic_pricing_rules_of_offer.title: Get automatic pricing rules of offer

get_badge_application.description: Use this resource to get a badge application details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
get_badge_application.title: Get badge application

After adding or updating the tax identification number the status will be NOT_VERIFIED and you will have to wait for acceptance status to start selling. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:read.
get_tax_identification_number.title: Get tax identification number

get_tax_settings_for_category.description: Use this resource to receive tax settings for a given leaf category. Based on received settings you may set VAT tax settings for your offers. The specification names no Allegro permission for it.

query.description: An identifier of a leaf category for which all available tax settings will be returned.
query.name: category.id

query.description: Country code for which tax settings will be returned. If not provided settings for all countries will be returned.
query.name: countryCode

get_tax_settings_for_category.title: Get tax settings for category

get_user_ratings_summary.description: Use this resource to receive feedback statistics. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:profile:read.
get_user_ratings_summary.title: Get user's ratings summary

get_warranties.description: Use this resource to get the seller's warranties. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.

query.description: The limit of elements in the response.
query.name: limit

query.description: The offset of elements in the response.
query.name: offset

get_warranties.title: Get warranties

get_warranty.description: Use this resource to get a warranty details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:read.
get_warranty.title: Get warranty

mark_message_thread_as_read.description: Use this resource to mark thread with provided identifier as read. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
mark_message_thread_as_read.title: Mark message thread as read

modify_many_offers.description: Use this resource to modify multiple offers at once. This resource is rate limited to 250 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute - limit applies to a single user of the application. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get offer modification command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
modify_many_offers.title: Modify many offers

parse_product_ingredients.description: Use this resource to parse raw, free-text ingredients declarations into structured ingredient lists for one or more products. Every submitted product text is parsed independently. The response contains parsed items together with errors and warnings detected for each product. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
parse_product_ingredients.title: Parse product ingredients

place_bid.description: Use this resource to place a bid in an auction. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:bids.
place_bid.title: Place bid

propose_product.description: Use this resource to propose a product. You can add up to 20,000 new products to the Catalog each month. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
propose_product.title: Propose product

propose_product_changes.description: Use this resource to propose changes in product. This resource is limited to 100 suggestions per day for a single user. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
propose_product_changes.title: Propose product changes

publish_or_end_offers.description: Use this resource to modify multiple offers publication at once. This resource is rate limited to 250 000 offer changes per hour or 9000 offer changes per minute. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get publication command summary. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
publish_or_end_offers.title: Publish or end offers

query_allegro_prices_status_of_offers.description: Use this resource to retrieve a list of offers and their status in the Allegro Prices program with optional filtering and pagination. Allows filtering by offer IDs, marketplace, and scope (WITH_DECLARATION, DISCOUNTED, or EXCLUDED). Only offers in ACTIVATING, ACTIVE, or ENDED statuses are considered. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
query_allegro_prices_status_of_offers.title: Query Allegro Prices status of offers

refund_payment.description: Use this endpoint to initiate a refund of a payment. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:payments:write.
refund_payment.title: Refund payment

reject_customer_return_refund.description: Use this resource to reject customer return refund with provided reason. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
reject_customer_return_refund.title: Reject customer return refund

request_rating_removal.description: Use this resource to request removal of received rating. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:ratings.
request_rating_removal.title: Request rating removal

request_shipment_pickup.description: Use this resource to request a pickup of shipments. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get pickup request status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:shipments:write.
request_shipment_pickup.title: Request shipment pickup

search_fundraising_campaigns.description: Use this resource to search fundraising campaigns. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. The specification names no Allegro permission for it.

query.description: Maximum number of returned results.
query.name: limit

query.description: Fundraising campaign name or it's Organization name prefix to search for.
query.name: phrase

search_fundraising_campaigns.title: Search fundraising campaigns

search_products.description: Use this resource to get a list of products according to provided parameters. At least ean or phrase parameter is required. This resource is limited with Leaky Bucket mechanism,. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:read.

query.description: Search phrase.
query.name: phrase

query.description: Search mode. If not specified, we are searching by GTIN, MPN, product's name, parameters, etc. - `GTIN` - restricts the search filtering to GTINs (Global Trade Item Number), e.g. EAN, ISBN, UPC. - `MPN` - restricts the search filtering to MPNs (Manufacturer Part Number).
query.name: mode

query.description: Language indicates the language for searching products. Allows to specify the language of the given phrase.
query.name: language

query.description: The category identifier to filter results. This can only be used when searching by phrase.
query.name: category.id

query.description: You can filter and customize your search results to find exactly what you need by applying filters ids and their dictionary values to query according to the flowing pattern: id=value. When the filter definition looks like: ```` { "id": "127448", "name": "Kolor", "type": "SINGLE", "values": [ { "name": "biały", "value": "127448_2" }, { "name": "czarny", "value": "127448_1" } ] } ```` You can use '…
query.name: Dynamic filters

query.description: A "cursor" to the next set of results.
query.name: page.id

query.description: Enables additional search options: - *SIMILAR_CATEGORIES* - searching in the indicated category (category.id) and in 'similar categories' (works only if category.id is a leaf category).
query.name: searchFeatures

search_products.title: Search products

send_message_in_dispute_or_claim.description: Use this resource to post a message in certain issue. At least one of fields: 'text', 'attachment' has to be present. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:disputes.
send_message_in_dispute_or_claim.title: Send message in dispute or claim

set_fulfillment_removal_preference.description: Use this resource to create new active removal preference. From the moment the preference is set, it becomes the active one, and all new system removal orders will be associated with this preference. Removal preference is associated with system removal order at the moment of removal order is created. It means there can be not yet fulfilled removal orders associated with previously set removal preference. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
set_fulfillment_removal_preference.title: Set fulfillment removal preference

set_order_serial_numbers.description: Use to set serial numbers in the given line items of seller order. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.

query.description: Checkout form revision.
query.name: checkoutForm.revision

set_order_serial_numbers.title: Set order serial numbers

set_order_status.description: Use to set seller order status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.

query.description: Checkout form revision.
query.name: checkoutForm.revision

set_order_status.title: Set order status

submit_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to submit the Advance Ship Notice. After this operation, updates of the Advance Ship Notice are limited to selected properties only. See PUT /fulfillment/advance-ship-notices/{id}/submitted. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get advance ship notice submission status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.

processing.check_title: Get advance ship notice submission status

submit_advance_ship_notice.title: Submit advance ship notice

submit_offer_to_alle_discount.description: Use this resource to create a command for submitting an offer. Offer will be submitted to the AlleDiscount campaign only if command is processed successfully. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get AlleDiscount submission status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
submit_offer_to_alle_discount.title: Submit offer to AlleDiscount

submit_offers_to_allegro_prices.description: Use this resource to submit a command to add offers to the Allegro Prices program. Returns a command ID that can be used to track the processing status. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get Allegro Prices submission status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
submit_offers_to_allegro_prices.title: Submit offers to Allegro Prices

suggest_categories.description: Use this resource to receive suggested categories for given phrase. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. The specification names no Allegro permission for it.

query.description: Product name for which you want to get suggested categories.
query.name: name

suggest_categories.title: Suggest categories

update_additional_services_group.description: Use this resource to modify existing additional service group. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_additional_services_group.title: Update additional services group

update_additional_services_group_transla.description: Use this resource to create/update translation for additional service group and specified language. It is allowed to provide an incomplete list of services that belong to the group. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_additional_services_group_transla.title: Update additional services group translation

update_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to update an Advance Ship Notice. If a client wants to update read-only property, an error is returned (only in cases when sent value will be different than actual on the server). Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.

headers.description: A current version of Advance Ship Notice (e.g. from etag header obtained via get).
headers.name: if-match

update_advance_ship_notice.title: Update advance ship notice

update_allegro_prices_participation.description: Use this resource to update the account participation status for one or more marketplaces in the Allegro Prices program. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
update_allegro_prices_participation.title: Update Allegro Prices participation

update_automatic_pricing_rule.description: Use this resource to update automatic pricing rule. This resource is rate limited to 5 requests per second. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
update_automatic_pricing_rule.title: Update automatic pricing rule

update_delivery_settings.description: Use this resource to modify the delivery settings declared by the seller. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_delivery_settings.title: Update delivery settings

update_flexible_bundle.description: You can update flexible bundle using this resource. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
update_flexible_bundle.title: Update flexible bundle

update_implied_warranty.description: Use this resource to modify the implied warranty details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_implied_warranty.title: Update implied warranty

update_offer_badge.description: This resource allows you to update a campaign badge for the given offer. You can use *Location* provided in header of the response to track your update status. Update offer price in a campaign or finish marking an offer in a campaign. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get badge operation. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
update_offer_badge.title: Update offer badge

update_offer_bundle_discount.description: Use this resource to update discount per marketplaces associated with bundle specified by its unique identifier. This will override currently set discounts for all marketplaces, so the unchanged discounts also must be specified in request. In case discount for marketplace is not specified in request it will be deleted. Allegro marks this operation as deprecated. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
update_offer_bundle_discount.title: Update offer bundle discount

update_offer_contact.description: Use this resource to modify contact details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_offer_contact.title: Update offer contact

update_offer_tag.description: Use this resource to update a tag. This resource is rate limited to 1 million changes per hour. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_offer_tag.title: Update offer tag

update_offer_translation.description: Update manual translation for offer. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
update_offer_translation.title: Update offer translation

update_point_of_service.description: Use this resource to modify a point of service. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_point_of_service.title: Update point of service

update_promotion.description: Use this resource to update a promotion by its unique id. It supports editing bundle's discount, wholesale price lists and large order discounts., Wholesale price list. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
update_promotion.title: Update promotion

update_responsible_person.description: Use this resource to update the responsible person for the compliance of the product with EU regulations. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_responsible_person.title: Update responsible person

update_responsible_producer.description: Use this resource to update the responsible producer for the compliance of the product with EU regulations. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_responsible_producer.title: Update responsible producer

update_return_policy.description: Use this resource to modify the return policy details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_return_policy.title: Update return policy

update_shipping_rate_set.description: Use this resource to edit a new seller's shipping rates set. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_shipping_rate_set.title: Update shipping rate set

update_size_table.description: Use this resource to update selected size table. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_size_table.title: Update size table

update_submitted_advance_ship_notice.description: Use this resource to update already submitted Advance Ship Notice. Update is allowed only when Advance Ship Notice is in "IN_TRANSIT" status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.

headers.description: A current version of Advance Ship Notice (e.g. from etag header obtained via get).
headers.name: if-match

update_submitted_advance_ship_notice.title: Update submitted advance ship notice

update_tax_identification_number.description: Use this resource to update tax identification number. For international sellers only. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:fulfillment:write.
update_tax_identification_number.title: Update tax identification number

update_warranty.description: Use this resource to modify the warranty details. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
update_warranty.title: Update warranty

upload_dispute_attachment_file.description: Upload a post purchase issue message attachment. This operation should be used after creating an attachment declaration with *POST /sale/issues/attachments* Important! You can find the URL address to upload the file to our server in the *Location* response header of *POST /sale/issues/attachments*. The URL is unique and one-time. As its format may change in time, you should always use the address from the header. Beta in Allegro: it may still change. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:disputes.
upload_dispute_attachment_file.title: Upload dispute attachment file

upload_message_attachment_file.description: Use this resource to upload attachment using identifier that was declared. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
upload_message_attachment_file.title: Upload message attachment file

upload_offer_attachment_file.description: Upload an offer attachment. This operation should be used after creating an offer attachment with *POST /sale/offer-attachments* Important! You can find the URL address to upload the file to our server in the *Location* response header of *POST /sale/offer-attachments*. The URL is unique and one-time. As its format may change in time, you should always use the address from the header. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.
upload_offer_attachment_file.title: Upload offer attachment file

upload_offer_image.description: Upload image to our servers. You can choose from two upload options: provide a link and we will download an image for you send an image as binary data Important! Remember to use dedicated domain for upload, i.e. https://upload.allegro.pl for Production https://upload.allegro.pl.allegrosandbox.pl for Sandbox. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:offers:write.

query.description: Sets the uploaded image to be marked as "AI". For a JSON request body (`application/vnd.allegro.public.v1+json`), this flag can also be provided in the request body. If both the query parameter and the request body are provided, their values must not conflict, otherwise a `400` response is returned.
query.name: isAiCoCreated

upload_offer_image.title: Upload offer image

upload_order_invoice_file.description: Use to upload invoice file to match created invoice metadata. Allegro marks this operation as deprecated. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
upload_order_invoice_file.title: Upload order invoice file

multipart.description: Invoice file in a binary format (PDF only)
multipart.name: file

upload_order_invoice_with_details.description: Use to add an invoice to the order in a single request - the invoice file together with its metadata are sent together, instead of the two-step flow (add invoice metadata, then upload invoice file). Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:orders:write.
upload_order_invoice_with_details.title: Upload order invoice with details

upload_warranty_attachment_file.description: Upload an after sale services attachment. This operation should be used after creating an offer attachment with *POST /sale/offer-attachments* Important! You can find the URL address to upload the file to our server in the *Location* response header of *POST /after-sales-service-conditions/attachments*. The URL is unique and one-time. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:sale:settings:write.
upload_warranty_attachment_file.title: Upload warranty attachment file

withdraw_offer_from_alle_discount.description: Use this resource to create a command for withdrawing an offer from specific campaign. Offer will be withdrawn from the AlleDiscount campaign only if command is processed successfully. Allegro registers the request and applies it afterwards: the step returns processing "accepted" and applied false. Get the outcome with Get AlleDiscount withdrawal status. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:campaigns.
withdraw_offer_from_alle_discount.title: Withdraw offer from AlleDiscount

write_message.description: Use this resource to write new message to recipient. This resource is rate limited to 1 request per second for a user. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
write_message.title: Write message

write_message_in_thread.description: Use this resource to write new message in existing thread. This resource is rate limited to 1 request per second for a user. Needs the Allegro permission allegro:api:messaging.
write_message_in_thread.title: Write message in thread
